title: Case 08: The Last Photograph
subtitle: A celebrity photographer is found dead in a locked gallery. His camera contains a photograph taken two minutes after his official time of death.
loop_reset_text: The camera shutter clicks in reverse. Wine rises into glasses. The gallery returns to 9:41 PM.

gallery.name: Main Gallery
gallery.description: White walls, expensive canvases and one body beneath a photograph that should not exist.

darkroom.name: Digital Darkroom
darkroom.description: Timers, memory cards and edit stations reveal what the camera was ordered to do after death.

rooftop.name: Rooftop Garden
rooftop.description: Wet footprints and long shadows expose when the famous final photograph was really staged.

office.name: Private Gallery Office
office.description: Insurance files and pigment reports hide a stolen-art operation.

nora.name: Nora Blake
dialogue: I left the rooftop before nine forty.
The final photo was not mine.

contradiction.result: Nora's prints are on the wine glass, but the camera timer proves the fatal photo was automated after she left.

adrian.name: Adrian Frost
dialogue: I left before the photographer died.
The rooftop image proves he was alive later.

contradiction.result: Shadow angle, forged pigment and alarm timing prove Adrian staged the later photograph to manufacture an alibi.

milo.name: Milo Chen
dialogue: The camera had interval mode enabled.
I never touched the memory card after nine thirty.

contradiction.result: Milo's workstation confirms interval mode and shows the missing card was removed by someone with gallery-office access.

sofia.name: Sofia Reyes
dialogue: The photographer told me originals were being swapped for copies.
The rooftop was empty when I went outside.

contradiction.result: Sofia's draft article and rooftop timing support her claim that she was investigating the same fraud.

evelyn.name: Evelyn Cross
dialogue: I bought what the gallery certified.

contradiction.result: Evelyn bought a forged work unknowingly; invoices point back to Adrian's private office.

timer.name: Interval Timer Setting
timer.description: The camera was programmed to fire automatically after the victim's death.

shadow.name: Shadow Direction
shadow.description: The final photograph's shadows match an earlier time, not its metadata timestamp.

pigment.name: Forged Painting Pigment
pigment.description: Modern pigment appears in a supposedly historic canvas.

card.name: Missing Memory Card
card.description: A second card containing provenance photos was removed.

wine.name: Wine-Glass Print
wine.description: Nora handled the glass during an earlier argument but left before the murder window.

alarm.name: Gallery Alarm Log
alarm.description: Adrian's office opened during the interval before the staged rooftop shot.

article.name: Unpublished Article
article.description: Sofia's draft accuses the gallery of swapping originals for copies.

invoice.name: Private Sale Invoice
invoice.description: Forged works were sold through a shell company controlled by Adrian.

timeline: 9:57 PM — Camera takes staged rooftop image.
deduction_prompt: Who killed the photographer and used an automated image to make him appear alive after death?
truth: Adrian killed the photographer to protect a forged-art scheme, then relied on the camera's interval timer and manipulated metadata to push the apparent time of death later. The rooftop shadows expose the trick.
partial: You identify Adrian but cannot fully prove how the post-mortem photograph was created.
wrong: Your theory leaves the delayed photograph and forged-art trail unexplained. The shutter rewinds.
